reference.initial_adapter_issue: Input prior workspace was 1152 bytes including padding; replay consumes the verified first 1144. Two guarded reads rejected the mismatch. One initial timeout had no primitive checkpoints; cause not uniquely established.

conventions.production_hf_modes: previous local replay output divided by 4 before native downstream; production input preflatten gains reused unchanged
conventions.sine_levels: zero for all 50 live envelopes; nonzero tone injection is outside this round
conventions.noise_table: previous independently verified 512-entry local table; no new table or index fitting
conventions.noise_cursor: native last used entry; next sample adds 1
conventions.assembly_model: pointwise Float64 multiply/add, rounded Float32; separate onset mask; no production rewrite
conventions.scope: current generated envelope samples only; no duplicated prefixes or carried-in samples

onset_observation.normative_status: open: P95/P99 omit onset noise in energy accounting; P102/P107 contain unconditional generation and addition; production follows latter literal sequence

local_artifact_digests.tree_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted relative path + NUL + file SHA256 + newline

limits: Reference limiter flags were changed only in owned primitive copies; this is not the public boost option A/B.
HF and assembled SNR use their own stage baselines; their difference is not a physical PCM improvement metric.
Full production wiring, later interleaving, QMF synthesis and object PCM propagation were not rerun.
The zero-sine live dataset cannot settle mixed sine/noise suppression.
Onset observation remains a normative consistency question, not an authorized production fix.
No proprietary native adapter, addresses, tables or raw matrices are included.
